description: This is a Java interface that defines the Target entity within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifying methods for retrieving target configurations such as address, topics, QoS, authorization, header mappings, payload mappings, and JSON serialization details.

classes.name: Target
classes.description: An interface representing a connection target with address, topics, QoS, authorization, header and payload mappings, and JSON serialization capabilities.

classes.name: Target.JsonFields
classes.description: A static container class defining JSON field definitions for the Target configuration properties such as address, topics, QoS, authorization context, acknowledgement label, header mapping, and payload mapping.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the address for the configured type of signals of this target.

methods.name: getOriginalAddress
methods.description: Returns the original address before placeholder resolution.

methods.name: withAddress
methods.description: Creates a copy of this Target with the address replaced by the specified new address.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Returns the set of topics that should be published via this target.

methods.name: getQos
methods.description: Returns the optional QoS value of this target, applicable for certain connection types.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the Authorization Context of this target, which overrides the connection’s context if set.

methods.name: getIssuedAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Returns the optional acknowledgement label for auto-issued acknowledgements.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns the optional header mapping for outbound message headers.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns the payload mappings to be applied for messages sent on this target.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts this Target instance to a JSON object including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson with schemaVersion and fieldSelector
methods.description: Serializes the Target to JSON with specified schema version and field selector.
